approval_note: Word list and house style approved by Alex, relayed by the PO session on 2026-11-08; items of this unit set verified: true the same day.

method.entries: Situation from the PO brief (report a production problem). The 5 brief words (Abweichung, Schwankung, Ausschuss, Ursache, Riss) were kept; added auftreten and Toleranz (needed to say what happened and against what limit) and 2 reporting phrases (Mir ist aufgefallen, dass …; Wir sollten der Sache nachgehen). Example sentences written by Claude from typical powder-metallurgy situations (batch density, flowability, cracks after sintering, scrap on gears); no company documents used. 9 entries, inside Alex's 5–10.
method.cefr: Assigned by Claude's judgement from the Goethe/telc B1 scope (in B1 scope: B1 or lower; specialist or beyond B1: B2). Not yet checked against the official Goethe B1 Wortliste.
method.house_style: Swiss Standard German: ss never ß; Swiss workplace words (Sitzung); du with colleagues, Sie with the boss. Approved by Alex 2026-11-08.
method.items: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote every item by hand from the approved entry, as a compact spec in a scratch Python script that only adds ids, source fields and the answer position; the script is not kept, the bank files are the record. Per word entry: 1 meaning_choice (German word in a short work sentence, marked 【 】, 4 Japanese meanings) and 1 cloze (work sentence with (　　), 4 German options in the same grammatical form). Per phrase entry: 1 phrase_choice (German situation, 4 German utterances) and, where a natural colleague line exists, 1 reply_choice (colleague's line + intention, 4 replies). Distractor rules: exactly one acceptable answer; distractors are real words or phrases from the same work setting; no distractor that is a second meaning of the target (e.g. no 委員会 for Ausschuss); grammar distractors only for frequent learner errors (verb position after Meiner Meinung nach, verb-final in dass/weil, wenn vs ob, sein vs haben); answer positions spread over 1–4. explanation_ja: 1–2 sentences in Japanese with the meaning, the key collocation or rule, German forms in Latin script; distractor_notes in Japanese give each wrong option's meaning or the error.
method.blind_check: Planned: Codex CLI gpt-6-luna; both gpt-6-luna and gpt-5.6-terra were out of quota until 2026-11-18. Stand-in: a fresh Claude Sonnet subagent that read only a blind file (id, mondai, stem, options; no key, no explanations), chose an answer per item and flagged items with more than one acceptable option, no correct option, unnatural German or a wrong Japanese option. Result for units B+C: 33/33 answers matched the key; 1 item flagged (dw-c-pc-ansicht: distractor 'Ich habe die Ansicht, dass …' judged acceptable German). Fix: replaced by 'Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob wir die Mischzeit verlängern sollten.' Defect rate 1/33 = 3 %. The fixed item was not re-solved.
method.approval: Alex approved the entry list and the house style on 2026-11-08 (relayed by the PO). Item wording itself was not reviewed by Alex or Yoko.
open: Re-run the blind solve with Codex after 2026-11-18.
Check CEFR levels against the Goethe B1 Wortliste once obtained.
Yoko's review: words she already knows, words her plant actually uses.
